Buy US solar equipment (SEDG, ENPH) for near-term beta, but rotate into Indonesian utilities (HGII) only after clarity on PLN procurement and tariff reform. Hedge IDR exposure via NRG-style cash-flow names.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Port infrastructure capex (Tanjung Priok, Patimban) is re-routing container flows and lifting land values for port-adjacent operators like SAFE and PPGL, a multi-year structural tailwind.
Cold-chain logistics is compounding at double-digit rates in Indonesia, driven by perishable e-commerce and food-service formalization, favoring specialized players (PSSI, CMNP) over general freight.
Toll-road network expansion in Java and Sumatra is structurally reducing transit times, making integrated logistics (MITI) more competitive versus fragmented trucking, supporting margin expansion.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian logistics names on the Port of Tanjung Priok expansion and e-commerce cold-chain demand; SAFE and PPGL lead on land-bank monetization and port throughput. Avoid broad sector beta—US logistics strength is non-transmissible. Accumulate MITI on toll-road connectivity gains, trim PSSI if volume growth stalls.
